description: This Java source file defines the CdyneServices class, which provides a service for retrieving city and state information based on a ZIP code using the CDyne web service. It includes methods for calling the external service, parsing XML responses, and handling errors.

classes.name: CdyneServices
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with the CDyne web service for address lookup.

methods.name: cdyneReturnCityState
methods.description: Calls the CDyne web service to retrieve city and state info based on ZIP code, parses the XML response, and handles errors.

methods.name: populateCdyneAddress
methods.description: Parses XML elements from the CDyne response and populates the response map with address details and error flags.
